title: PyRIT readable obfuscation: leetspeak, confusables, spacing, NATO, acrostic (6)
what: PyRIT 1.2.1 converters that keep the instruction readable to a model: leetspeak, look-alike letters, spaced characters, NATO spelling, acrostic, unicode replacement. One sample each, stored and served with no warning today. The checks state what a defence should do (hold it). Marked a known gap. Samples: src/attack-sets/data-garak-pyrit-2026-11.ts; the replay is in docs/ai-redteam-tools-2026-11-23.md.
